claim_ceiling: Budget-matched comparison of objective task competence across communication topologies in a synthetic swarm optimizer; not a universal collective-intelligence, life, agency, or consciousness score

scientific_premise.paradigm: Measure what the group accomplishes under equal resources; do not use alignment, consensus, transfer entropy, or graph density as a proxy for task competence.
scientific_premise.task_competence_definition: Externally scored task performance under a registered objective, resource budget, communication budget, and controlled starting distribution.

implementation.source: Nitti et al. (2025), Nature Communications 16, 6572, DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-61985-7
implementation.evaluation_accounting: N agents and T completed updates require N*(T+1) objective evaluations under the cached initial/successor observation contract.
implementation.status: Rust instrumentation and equal-budget unit tests added; execution awaits exact-head CI.

landscapes.role: multiple local optima and topology-dependent search robustness

frozen_initial_conditions.seed_list_generation: registered deterministic seed list, beginning at 20261112; publish exact 100-seed list before full sweep

resource_contract.energy_and_latency_measurement: not yet instrumented; do not claim physical resource parity until those costs are measured

baseline_portfolios.purpose: geometry-limited communication with an explicit positive radius; keep separate from no-communication control
explicit empty adjacency; no inter-agent messages even for coincident agents; local gradient-only update
each agent follows only its own local gradient; no social coupling or consensus
randomly sample positions using the same total objective-evaluation budget
centralized optimizer under the same total objective-evaluation count; communication/controller costs reported separately
computes exact simple-regret lower bound; not counted as an operational baseline

success_criteria.statistical_unit: independent matched initialization seed and complete optimizer run
success_criteria.confidence_intervals: 95% interval over independent seeds; not time frames or per-agent measurements
success_criteria.primary_comparison: difference in success rate and final best-so-far fitness at exactly the same objective-evaluation budget
success_criteria.superiority_rule: only claim a communication-topology advantage if the paired-seed confidence interval for task utility excludes zero and no hard budget is exceeded

adversarial_controls.purpose: A coherent but suboptimal cluster must not be awarded task-competence credit from consensus alone.
A shared exogenous signal may synchronize agents without direct messages; co-motion is not a communication or competence claim.
adversarial_controls.scoring: separate exogenous-driver, communication and objective metrics

adversarial_controls.purpose: Compare CompleteGraph, Ring, MetricRadius and radius-zero under matched function calls.
adversarial_controls.scoring: paired-seed performance delta, edge count, evaluation budget

adversarial_controls.purpose: Test whether premature consensus traps the swarm in a suboptimal basin.
adversarial_controls.scoring: global-optimum success rate, regret, recovery after topology changes

adversarial_controls.purpose: Any optimizer that exceeds the function-evaluation budget is inadmissible regardless of final fitness.

source_benchmark_context.scm_source_report: Nitti et al. (2025) report SCM success-rate parity or better than PSO/MIPA on 22 of 33 evaluated low-dimensional tasks for M<=16, with about one order of magnitude more function evaluations in aggregate. Their five-AUV contaminant-localization result reports 86% success over 100 simulations and is a computational proof of concept, not a physical fleet trial.
source_benchmark_context.comparison_warning: Do not interpret 22/33 as a universal superiority claim. OLI must reproduce matched tasks and budgets, with evaluation counts and source equation variants explicit.
source_benchmark_context.other_sota_methods: Include task-matched alternatives only after pinning their exact objective, initialization, stopping rule and evaluation budget.

anti_leakage: Use identical initial positions and seed list across communication topologies.
Keep all time steps within one run in the same statistical unit.
Do not tune topology radius or hyperparameters on the sealed seed/landscape set.
Publish full seed-level outcomes, including failures and outliers.
Do not combine different SCM sine kernels or consensus-window interpretations into one aggregate.
The independent/no-message arm must use the explicit NoCommunication topology, not MetricRadius(0), because coincident agents are neighbours at zero metric distance.
acceptance: Each step reports current and best-seen objective fitness separately from consensus.
The N*(T+1) objective evaluation count is exactly equal across topology baselines.
Independent and centralized baselines use the same measured objective-evaluation budget.
Simple regret and success-at-threshold are evaluated against exact optimum.
At least 100 matched seeds are completed on both landscapes.
Any claim of group-level advantage includes paired uncertainty intervals and communication cost.
High consensus alone never qualifies as collective competence.
NoCommunication topology produces empty adjacency for all coordinate configurations, including coincident agents.
status_note: This manifest freezes a benchmark contract. The SCM fitness metrics and topology budget test are implemented, but no benchmark sweep, performance win, or source reproduction has yet been executed.
